title: Import contacts from a spreadsheet
blurb: Bring your existing customers in from Excel or a CSV file.

steps.title: Get your file ready
steps.body: Save your spreadsheet as a CSV file. Keep a header row with column names like First Name, Phone and Email. Each person needs at least a name, email or phone.
steps.tip: Files can be up to 30 MB. Try a small test file of 5 rows first.

steps.title: Upload your file
steps.body: Choose to import contacts, then drag your CSV in. Pick whether to create new contacts, update existing ones, or both.

steps.title: Match the columns
steps.body: Check each column in your file is matched to the right Luubu field. Fix any that aren't, and make sure the required fields are mapped.

steps.title: Tag them
steps.body: Add a tag like "imported-2026" so you can find this group later. You can also create a smart list for them.

steps.title: Confirm and import
steps.body: Confirm you have permission to contact these people, then start the import. Check progress under the **Bulk Actions** tab.
